qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Sole fixed-link tunnel concession connecting the UK and continental Europe to 2086. While railway access tariffs track inflation, immense capital intensity and fixed capital base constrain multi-cycle capital returns: median GAAP ROIC is 7.3% (tangible ROIC 7.6%), failing the 12% hurdle. Cross-Channel ferry competition and airline alternatives also constrain pricing freedom on passenger and truck shuttles.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Proof of Moat & ROIC, REJECT). Unique, unreplicable Channel Tunnel fixed link concession through 2086 with inflation-linked tariffs, but capital efficiency is permanently constrained by extreme capital intensity, yielding a 4-year median GAAP ROIC of only 7.33% (tangible ROIC 7.5%), well below the 12% Munger threshold.
qualitative.evidence: Historical capital efficiency consistently fails the 12% GAAP ROIC standard: FY2022 GAAP ROIC 6.78% (tangible 6.97%), FY2023 7.64% (tangible 7.87%), FY2024 7.28% (tangible 7.54%), FY2025 7.39% (tangible 7.69%), median ROIC 7.33%. Net debt remains elevated at €3.57B (€4.92B LT debt vs €1.35B cash; ~11x net income). Under the v6.23 specification, sub-12% ROIC triggers rejection at Gate 3b.
